name: codex-advisor
description: Keep Codex in the advisor role while a selected agent performs implementation work.

interface.shortDescription: Codex advises while another agent implements.
interface.longDescription: Codex inspects the repository, defines an implementation contract, delegates every file change to a selected executor, and independently reviews the resulting diff and verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor to specify this task, delegate implementation, and verify the result.
